card.name: The word of after professor
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after an academic rank such as assistant, associate or full professor, just before the department or field name.

modes.label: Professor of a field
modes.description: "of" follows a professor title in a person's byline or introduction, before a subject such as physics or English.
modes.example: Illah Nourbakhsh, associate professor<< of>> robotics and head of the CREATE Lab.

card.plain: It fires on the "of" in "professor of ...", just before the person's academic field is named.
